verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a REST API for managing datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs and more, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec for use with your own tooling. That gives a reference you could load into external clients, but nothing shows the docs themselves are interactive or have runnable examples. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at common well-known paths, but that does not contradict the documented download option. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable/try-it request examples, and hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
